column1: # Every source the roster is built from. Tab-separated, `#` starts a comment.
# key         what the build reports on its `sources:` line, and the name
#             config/alumni/expected-empty-sources.txt refers to. Do not rename.
# kind        archived | spotlight | live — the three fetch shapes.
#             archived  = enumerate the Wayback captures, grab one per digest
#             spotlight = the wildcard sweep that recovers each post's own URL
#             live      = fetch the page the club publishes today
# prefix      the cache filename prefix. `<prefix>-<stamp>.html` for archived and
# cdx_pattern the Wayback CDX url pattern; `-` where the kind does not use one.
# url         the original URL to retrieve; `-` where the sweep recovers it.
# read this file and neither keeps its own copy. The fetcher retrieves exactly
# what is declared here; the build checks every key declared here for a yield,
# whether or not it produced a cached page, and refuses a cached page whose
# prefix nothing here claims. Adding a source is one row.
# the same page renamed in 2017; the only source for project leads 2017-2019
